name: syncscript-workspace
description: Workspace automation for the SyncScript extension and signaling server

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace extension && npm run typecheck --workspace signaling
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace signaling && npm run compile --workspace extension && npm run tailwind:build --workspace extension
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace signaling && npm run test --workspace extension
scripts.package:vsix: npm run compile --workspace extension && npm run tailwind:build --workspace extension && node scripts/stage-runtime-deps.js && npm run vsce-pack --workspace extension
scripts.start:signaling: npm run build --workspace signaling && npm run start:prod --workspace signaling
